quotes.text: "Proof is checked in Lean" is kinda similar to assuming your code works just because it compiles. Sure, the proof is valid, but does it prove what you set out to prove?
quotes.author: wodenokoto
quotes.source: Hacker News — "...and the proof is checked in Lean"
quotes.extraction_note: Great analogy between 'it compiles' and 'it's proven' — collapses both into the same grug insight.

quotes.text: Beware of bugs in the above code; I have only proved it correct, not tried it.
quotes.author: Donald Knuth

quotes.extraction_note: Classic Knuth line, timeless and perfectly quotable — surfaced in a modern Lean thread.
